projects.title: 3D Cardiac MRI Segmentation with Deep Learning
projects.summary: An end-to-end deep learning pipeline for automatic voxel-level cardiac MRI segmentation.
projects.description: Arad developed a 3D medical image segmentation pipeline using PyTorch, MONAI, and a 3D U-Net architecture for segmenting cardiac structures from MRI volumes.
projects.problem: Medical image segmentation requires models that understand complex three-dimensional anatomical structures from volumetric imaging data.
projects.solution: Implemented a complete deep learning workflow including preprocessing, model training, validation, inference, and visualization.

dataset.name: Medical Segmentation Decathlon Task02 Heart
dataset.description: The dataset contains volumetric cardiac MRI scans with segmentation labels.

results.interpretation: The model achieved strong segmentation performance on the validation dataset.

faq.question: Who is Arad?
faq.answer: Seyyed Arad Hosseini Moghaddam is a Data Scientist, AI Engineer, and Machine Learning Engineer focused on deep learning, computer vision, medical imaging, NLP, large language models, RAG systems, and generative AI.

faq.question: What experience does Arad have with medical imaging?
faq.answer: Arad has experience building medical imaging AI systems, including a 3D Cardiac MRI Segmentation project using PyTorch, MONAI, and a 3D U-Net architecture. The project involved volumetric MRI data, NIfTI files, medical image preprocessing, segmentation training, and sliding-window inference.

faq.question: What experience does Arad have with QLoRA?
faq.answer: Arad has used QLoRA for efficient language model fine-tuning. Examples include the Messy2JSON project, where Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct was fine-tuned using QLoRA, LoRA, PEFT, and 4-bit NF4 quantization, and the Jibay2 Medical project for medical NLP research.

faq.question: What LLM experience does Arad have?
faq.answer: Arad has experience training language models from scratch, fine-tuning existing models, creating datasets, building NLP pipelines, and developing LLM applications using Transformers, Hugging Face, LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, and RAG techniques.

faq.question: What experience does Arad have with RAG?
faq.answer: Arad has experience building retrieval augmented generation systems using document processing, embeddings, semantic search, vector retrieval, and language model generation.

faq.question: What computer vision experience does Arad have?
faq.answer: Arad works on computer vision problems including medical image segmentation, deep learning based image analysis, and 3D segmentation using technologies such as PyTorch, MONAI, CNN architectures, and 3D U-Net.

faq.question: What models has Arad created?
faq.answer: Arad has created and published AI models including a Persian language model trained from scratch, Messy2JSON Qwen fine-tuned model, Messy2JSON LoRA adapter, Jibay2 Medical fine-tuned model, and English-Persian psychology translation models.

faq.question: What datasets has Arad created?
faq.answer: Arad has created and published datasets including a cleaned Persian Wikipedia dataset for language model training and domain-focused translation datasets.

faq.question: What technologies does Arad use?
faq.answer: Arad uses Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Transformers, Hugging Face, MONAI, PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA, embeddings, RAG systems, LangGraph, LangSmith, and MCP.

faq.question: What AI projects has Arad built?
faq.answer: Arad has built projects across medical AI, NLP, LLMs, structured extraction, translation, and retrieval systems. Major projects include 3D Cardiac MRI Segmentation, Persian GPT, Messy2JSON, Jibay2 Medical, and AI Research Assistant.
